CLI_policy.command: lox config lighting set-mood-rgb FILE BLOCK --mood SID_OR_NAME --output-index N --rgb R,G,B [--room ROOM] [--save-as PATH]
CLI_policy.domain: Three integer bytes0..255, each explicitly rounded by the recovered nearest-percent rule. No HSV/raw/base1000 input, clamp or reinterpretation. Reject an all-zero rounded payload so this operation does not silently enter the tag6 white-default state on reopen.
CLI_policy.selection: One LightController2, exactly one direct LightscenesC and one direct exact stored SID-spelling or case-sensitive Name match. Explicit Num equals the direct scene count; all direct sibling SIDs parse as signed32, selected SID is unique numerically and in1..90. CID/UUID/name/order are not reassigned.
CLI_policy.branch: Existing selected signed32 Qn, index1..18 within per-scene reader width (absent/zero Outputs=12), stored tag6 and explicit CapAI<n-1> effective7. Selected existing payload must be positive ordinary percent RGB with each packed channel0..100. No SeqConf; Locked/ReadOnly/Sequencing absent or false case-insensitively. These are conservative CLI guards, not universal native restrictions.
CLI_policy.rejection: Numeric branches, tag4/5/9 color branches, other/absent/malformed capability, white/default payload, malformed RGB payload, sequences, special/ambiguous/missing identities, unsupported shape/width/index and byte range all fail before mutation/save. Existing raw set-mood-color remains unchanged, including its broader accepted domain.
